verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own rule-based automation for triage. Users can create rules that automatically assign errors (bugsnag-docs-41, bugsnag-docs-2), and integrations such as PagerDuty create incidents automatically when errors arrive (bugsnag-docs-9), so some configured automations do run unattended in the background. This is narrow, fixed-purpose rule automation rather than a general automation or agent framework. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or workflow builder, autonomous agent-driven actions beyond assignment and alerting, scheduling or trigger configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
